kind: release specification, prospective: fixed before any v0.0.3 candidate is evaluated
relation_to_v002: v0.0.2's files (release_gate_v002.json, evaluation_manifest_v002_final.json, GATE_ACCEPTANCE_V002.json) stay unchanged. This specification keeps v0.0.2's thresholds and changes three things: verified server provenance is required, the judgment gates are diagnostic only, and every denominator is defined.

provenance.check: provenance.verify(run_dir)['status'] for every run the verdict reads: candidate and matched baseline, development and holdout
provenance.consequence: a run whose status is not 'verified' fails the gate; --allow-unverified runs and every receipt from a server without a load-time digest are not 'verified'
provenance.decided_by: Jonathan, 13 Nov 2026 (engineering audit, items B11 and provenance)

operations.export_parity_evidence: supplied by the operator from the export parity check; the evaluator cannot compute it, and the gate cannot pass without it

units.case: one scenario of the suite; greedy repeats of a case are one case, not several
units.case_passes: every repeat of the case passes its exact check (with repeat_identical_fraction 1.0 this is the same as its first repeat)
units.dev_exact_denominator: the scored development cases: development cases whose check kind is 'exact' (11 of the 13 development cases of suite_release_v002.json; open_friend and open_hobby are unscored)
units.family_denominator: the scored development cases of that family (two each for immediate_recall, delayed_recall and correction)
units.chosen_by: Claude Opus 5.5, 13 Nov 2026 (engineering audit, item B2), because unscored cases cannot pass; Jonathan may override this choice in a later version
units.known_when_chosen: v0.0.2 left the denominator undefined. Development outputs of the S-full baseline and of 71 screening models had been read when this was chosen, and three screening models (S67, S72s2, S71s2) pass exactly 3 of 11 scored cases, which meets 0.25 over 11 but not over 13. None of those models is a v0.0.3 candidate.

transfer.meaning: held-out instances of trained skills, not transfer to untrained behaviour

judgments.reported: relevance and coherence: the fraction of judged turns rated 3 or more, with the counts of judged and failed calls
judgments.reason: the recorded calibration covers four final replies, the judgment rates every turn of five cases, and no agreement criterion is fixed; uncalibrated ratings are reported, never pass or fail

semantic_content.meaning: answer mention and negation flags, not semantic correctness; adjudicate every fail-to-pass flip from the transcripts

stated_limits: Missing information: the three 'Have I told you ...?' cases (unknown_name, unknown_pet, transfer_unknown) all have the gold answer 'no' and none asks about a fact that was supplied, so a model that answers 'No.' to any yes/no question passes them. Their passes count toward dev_exact_min and holdout_exact_min under this specification; read them with the replies.
Counts and denominators, not population estimates: 11 development and 8 holdout authored cases; greedy repeats do not multiply cases.
The holdout gold is public: holdout separation is operator separation, not secrecy.
Server provenance is the server's own report: it guards against operator error and stale or swapped servers, not against a server that misreports.
proposed_next_suite: Not built here. A new suite version, frozen before any candidate is read, would pair each missing-information case with a matched case whose fact was supplied (gold 'yes'), so that a constant answer passes at most half of the family.

stopping.candidate_budget: set by the training admission that names v0.0.3 candidates, before any of them is evaluated; this specification holds no budget of its own
stopping.failure: retain the baseline, publish every outcome, no automatic added steps or candidates

verdicts.incomplete: no required criterion fails, but one cannot yet be evaluated (for example, the holdout runs or the export parity evidence are not supplied)
